title: AIIR Agent-Receipt Profile v0.1
description: Draft JSON Schema for the AIIR agent-receipt profile (aiir/agent_receipt.v0.1), a portable receipt record for agent-assisted software actions. Companion to the existing AIIR commit-receipt profile (aiir/commit_receipt.v2).

record_id.description: Content-addressed record identifier derived from the canonical record core. 128-bit truncation; the full hash is retained in proof.content_hash. Parallel to the commit-receipt 'g1-' prefix.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp for the emitted record.

name.description: Lowercase ASCII tool label such as copilot, claude-code, cursor, windsurf, warp, devin, github-actions, or unknown. Implementations MUST normalize to lowercase before emission. The label is informational only and is not authenticated unless the record is signed.

surface.description: Optional surface label such as vscode-agent, cli, github-app, gitlab-job, or mcp. Lowercase ASCII.

session_ref.description: Optional tool-local session or conversation reference. MUST NOT contain identifiers that map to a natural person; SHOULD be opaque or hashed if any identifying input is included.

intent.description: Optional tool-native action name such as apply_patch, pytest, or fetch_webpage.

summary.description: Optional human-readable summary of the action.

reasons.description: Stable reason codes or short text strings.

contract_ref.description: Optional link or identifier for the policy contract that produced this decision.

canonicalization.description: Canonicalization profile identifier used to derive the content hash. v0.1 implementations SHOULD use 'aiir-canon-0' (the same profile as the AIIR commit-receipt profile).

content_hash.description: Full SHA-256 hash of the canonical record core. record_id is a 128-bit truncation of this hash.

signature.description: Optional signature metadata. Signature envelope semantics are intentionally draft-stage and vendor-neutral. When absent, the actor.tool.name field is informational only and is NOT authenticated.

extensions.description: Optional namespaced extension fields. Keys SHOULD use reverse-DNS or 'x-vendor-' prefixes (e.g., 'io.invariantsystems.aiir', 'x-cursor-context'). Extensions are excluded from record_core in v0.1 and therefore do not affect content_hash or record_id; treat extensions as informational metadata only.

ref.description: Portable reference such as a path, URL, commit SHA, or test name.

role.description: Optional subtype such as source, result, evidence, or external.
